subject.title: [Bug]: Compaction triggers at 9-16% context usage despite 1M window and 30K reserve floor

question: Does current main’s safeguard/GLM auto-compaction guard fully cover this v2026.7.1 reproduction, or can another compaction trigger still fire during model and delivery transitions?
rationale: Source shows a targeted guard, but closing requires either its exact fix provenance plus coverage evidence or a current-main retest showing the reported sequence no longer compacts.

options.title: Verify current main first
options.body: Request a retest on a current-main build or next beta and add focused regression coverage before deciding whether further repair is needed.

options.title: Treat as already fixed
options.body: Close only after identifying the guard’s introducing commit, timestamp, release status, and tests proving it covers this transition sequence.

recommendation.title: Verify current main first
recommendation.body: Request a retest on a current-main build or next beta and add focused regression coverage before deciding whether further repair is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The context-engine integration boundary now applies the compaction guard and is the closest evidenced ownership path.
